message.content: Comments in this codebase use lowercase text with square-bracket annotations to serve as a lightweight, machine-parseable annotation system rather than human-readable prose. The lowercase convention (`## read config ##` not `## Read Config ##`) keeps the text uniform and avoids the variability of capitalization, making it easier for tooling to scan and parse consistently. The square-bracket annotations (`[ word ]`) act as structured metadata markers — they denote intent, edge cases, or metadata about the code block itself (like `[ io watcher ]` or `[ false-mode reply ]`) without bloating the code with verbose docstrings. This style is tuned for the P7 multi-agent system where code is often read by agents and tooling, not just humans; it's a pragmatic tradeoff that favors parseability and compactness over traditional documentation, fitting the terse, tool-first philosophy of the project.
